name: Tamao
source:
Died right after birth from an accident, and saved by the heroine while wandering through Hell.

He's adored her ever since, and currently lives with her. Tamao is especially proud of his fangs that can bite anything to shreds.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/tamao/]Aksys Games[/url]]
